config.legal_blocks: 20 valid adjacent original observed sessions with consecutive calendar_index; noncircular; no cross-fold or partial
config.rng_order: numpy default_rng; replicate outer loop, fixed complete-fold inner order; uniform starts with replacement within each fold
config.support_stop: Any valid point date c=0 -> CC_BLOCK_COVERAGE; any fold K<2 -> CC_INSUFFICIENT_BLOCKS. Never drop dates, shorten block or replace method.
config.within_fold_weight: inverse legal-block coverage c_fd on centered residual z_fd=x_fd-mu_f

config.calibration_admission: All4 Wilson95 coverage lower bounds>=0.93; report coverage/hits/Wilson95/mean_width; any failure blocks real x/CI, no tuning
config.calibration_failure_action: Complete four predeclared synthetic cases; then CC_CI_CALIBRATION and no real x access
config.canary: 64draws each iid andMA5 on accepted date mask, resource/throughput only; not formal admission
config.crossfold_covariance: Included at actual calendar lag; no artificial fold cut
config.information_gate: point>=0.0005 && CIlo>0 &&positivefolds>=4 &&overall>=.8 &&each>=.7; CIhi<.0005 below else inconclusive
config.innovation_generation: For each draw generate5 prefix + every full global calendar slot from first to last primary valid index; then select547valid dates. Prefix5 avoids truncated MA boundary.
config.point_and_gates: Copy accepted real point/fold means/coverage/positivefolds; no recompute
config.residual: accepted daily x minus accepted fold mean; no re-estimation on real data
config.synthetic_estimator: Re-estimate sample fold means and point each draw; truth weighted fixed n/N true foldmeans
config.workers2: Not activated without measured throughput gain and healthy resource evidence; this batch uses bounded serial vectorized execution

bootstrap.method: noncircular moving blocks, within fold, original calendar index difference exactly1; resample complete date cross-sections

config.AR: r_t=.9*r_prev+sqrt(1-.9**2)*u_t; zero initialization discard512; same recurrence all AR scenarios
config.cal_order: k=min{k in1..50000:BinomCDF(k-1;50000,.95)>=1-.01/8}; kth smallest absT, no interpolation
config.family_confidence: 99% simultaneous MonteCarlo upper quantile confidence for specified eight DGPs only; NOT real95% coverage certificate
config.information_gate: unchanged point>=.0005 && lo>0 &&positivefolds>=4 &&coverageoverall>=.8 &&each>=.7; hi<.0005 below else inconclusive
config.locking: register immutable QSTAR_LOCK sha binding all8cal result/receipt/core/config before any phase1 validation; reject q drift/recal
config.optional_workers2: not admitted without measured gain/healthy resources; serial default sufficient
config.real_ci: accepted point +- locked qstar*sqrt(V); at most one formal real CI after all validation PASS
config.recovery: atomic hashed RNG state+all absT/SE arrays; exclusive case owner; exact science identity; successful cases reused; registered short checkpoint capture start/terminal
config.synthetic_estimator: simulate full601 then select547; reestimate foldmeans and equal-day point every sample; truth=sum(n_f/N*true_mu_f)
config.validation: all8 phase1 Wilson95lower>=.93 using fixed1.959963984540054 for Wilson; otherwise STOP no realx/CI
config.variance: V=(N/tr(KM))*zKz/N^2; X five fold dummies M=I-X inv(XtX) Xt; real z=accepted daily x-accepted fold mean

bootstrap.methodology: moving noncircular 20 consecutive observed-session blocks, never cross fold or missing paired-date gaps; paired arm resampling; draw ceil(N/20) blocks and truncate to N

config.evaluation_dates: only dates with all ten h2 selected outcomes finite in BOTH arms; disclose excluded pairs; never change scoring pool
config.month_anchor: shared calendar_index(D)+1; asof cutoff remains D.year even on December/January boundary
config.prior_window: 2006 <= year < signal_date.year; complete prior calendar years only
config.selection: daily Top10 stable descending score / ascending canonical code tie break; no refill

config.absolute_remove3: H-E descending, year ascending ties; remove3; recompute remaining L and S
config.annual_S: annual cell L / annual industry L; undefined if industry L<=0 or expected<=0
config.comparison: strict >1 and >=1.2; no p-values or significance claims
config.eligible: 20 supported cell years and total expected>=100; UNKNOWN/unmapped excluded from conclusions
config.few_year_inflated: eligible and corresponding pooled L/S>=1.2, (positive years<=10 OR median<=1), corresponding remove3 L/S<=1; S needs20 finite years
config.half_and_remaining_baselines: recompute ratios from sums using identical retained years; never average lifts
config.limits: current-industry retrospective; same-day observed-package Top100; no all-market/PIT/official complete-adjustment or future-return prediction claim
config.pooled_S: pooled cell L / pooled industry L; descriptive ratio affected by annual composition
config.positive_excess_share: sum positive excess of removed years / sum positive excess of all finite years, only if denominator>0
config.report_selection: top12 robust entries by minimum(MAIN S,EX S), then minimum L, then expected descending and key/month/third ascending; absolute-only month and month-third sections rank minimum L first; top20 common industries by MAIN expected; mandatory C40 November and I65 January/February with actual gate results; at most6 inflated/half-period-crossing examples; all rows retained
config.robust: corresponding stable criteria pass separately in MAIN and EX_RESUMED
config.seasonal_remove3: H-E*annual industry L descending, year ascending ties; remove3 finite years; undefined if fewer than3 finite
config.stable_absolute: eligible and L>=1.2, >=15/20 annual L>1, median L>1, both half L>1, absolute remove3 L>1
config.stable_seasonal_only: eligible and all20 S finite, S>=1.2, >=15/20 annual S>1, median S>1, both half S>1, seasonal remove3 S>1
config.stage_example: eligible both populations, not robust seasonal, at least one half-period L or S crosses1; descriptive stage contrast only
